headline: Quebecor Reports Wireless Revenue Growth and Strong Subscriber Gains
summary: Quebecor shares climbed after the telecom company added nearly 137,000 new wireless customers in the quarter, marking its largest mobile subscriber increase since launching service in 2010.
why: Telecommunications subscriber additions and mobile revenue growth are vital indicators of market share capture and top-line expansion in competitive carrier markets.

impacts.why: Strong subscriber additions and higher wireless revenue directly improve financial performance.
